system.description: You throw the rig broadside and scrape it along the line. Drive the rig up to its speed and test Agility (DR14). On a success, each creature adjacent to its path takes d8 damage and is pushed 5' away from it. Whatever the result, the rig takes d4 damage.

outcomes.failure: Half damage, and no one is pushed.
outcomes.ruin: No damage, and you lose control as on a driving test Failure.
